completed_movement_cycles.measurement_definition: Complete top-bottom-top intervals emitted by the frozen phase segmentation pipeline.
completed_movement_cycles.quality_requirements: A reliable selected phase signal and a complete configured cycle.

display.unavailable: A reliable repetition count was not available.

completed_movement_cycles.limitation: A completed movement cycle is not a certification of technique.

body_alignment_deviation.measurement_definition: Visible shoulder-hip-ankle angular deviation and normalized perpendicular hip displacement.
body_alignment_deviation.persistence_requirements: Angle > 8 degrees OR normalized displacement > 0.08, for >= 25% and >= 250 ms continuously.

display.adequate: No deviation detected in this check

body_alignment_deviation.flagged_explanation: The visible shoulder-hip-ankle line deviated beyond the experimental threshold for a sustained part of this repetition.
body_alignment_deviation.action: Replay the highlighted interval and review your body position.

push_up_depth_proxy.measurement_definition: Minimum observable elbow angle in the configured +/-250 ms bottom window.
push_up_depth_proxy.quality_requirements: At least two bottom-window samples and condition-specific reliability gates.
push_up_depth_proxy.comparison: condition_detected when minimum elbow angle > 110 degrees

display.adequate: No deviation detected in this check

push_up_depth_proxy.flagged_explanation: The observed elbow-angle proxy did not meet the current experimental depth criterion.
push_up_depth_proxy.action: Replay the bottom position. Ask a trainer to interpret the range of motion if you are unsure.
push_up_depth_proxy.limitation: This camera proxy does not establish chest-to-floor contact.

head_neck_alignment.measurement_definition: Signed perpendicular ear distance from the visible shoulder-hip line, normalized by pixel torso length.
head_neck_alignment.quality_requirements: Required landmarks pass visibility/presence gates in at least 70% of repetition frames; supported viewpoint, reliable phase and viewpoint confidence required.
head_neck_alignment.comparison: condition_detected when absolute normalized deviation > 0.15 for >= 30% and >= 200 ms continuously.
head_neck_alignment.flagged_title: Review head and neck position in repetition {rep_id}.
head_neck_alignment.flagged_explanation: The head was not aligned with the spine for a sustained part of this repetition.
head_neck_alignment.action: Review the side-view recording and keep your head approximately in line with your torso.
head_neck_alignment.limitation: Head position estimated from 2D landmarks; exact cervical spine angle not measured.

elbow_to_torso_flare.measurement_definition: Projected angle between upper arm and shoulder-midpoint to hip-midpoint vector in pixel coordinates.
elbow_to_torso_flare.quality_requirements: Required landmarks pass visibility/presence gates in at least 70% of repetition frames; supported viewpoint, reliable phase and viewpoint confidence required.
elbow_to_torso_flare.comparison: condition_detected when projected flare angle > 60 degrees for >= 30% and >= 200 ms continuously.
elbow_to_torso_flare.flagged_explanation: The projected upper-arm/torso angle exceeded the experimental threshold for a sustained interval.
elbow_to_torso_flare.action: Tuck your elbows closer to your body - aim for approximately 45 degrees from your torso, not flared out to 90 degrees.
elbow_to_torso_flare.limitation: Camera-based flare estimation from oblique view is approximate; exact 3D joint angles not measured.

hand_placement.measurement_definition: Each wrist X offset from its corresponding shoulder, normalized by projected shoulder width; zero means laterally aligned.
hand_placement.quality_requirements: Required landmarks pass visibility/presence gates in at least 70% of repetition frames; supported viewpoint, reliable phase and viewpoint confidence required.
hand_placement.comparison: condition_detected when absolute wrist offset > 0.3 shoulder-widths for >= 30% and >= 200 ms continuously.
hand_placement.flagged_explanation: Your hands were positioned too far from under your shoulders for a sustained part of this repetition.
hand_placement.action: Place your hands approximately under your shoulders - not too wide, not too narrow.
hand_placement.limitation: Experimental 2D lateral placement proxy only; does not measure forward/back placement, palm contact, or force. Keep the camera level; perspective affects this measurement.

coverage_definition: Answered body-alignment, depth-proxy, head-neck, elbow-flare and hand-placement assessments divided by those eligible assessments emitted for detected repetitions.
